about: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/supply_chain.py (north star 34.2-10, 34.2-17, 34.17-6). A licence entry clears one package whose licence, exactly as the SBOM reads it, is copyleft (strong or weak) or not machine-readable. An advisory entry clears one advisory id or alias for one package. A component entry clears one exact version of a component no advisory database covers. An entry counts only when `reviewed_by` names the person who reviewed it (no placeholder) and `until` is a date that has not passed; until then it is listed as awaiting review and clears nothing. The proposed entries below carry over the project's own record in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and wait for the release lead or the owner to sign them before the public 1.0 (amendment A19: betas are exempt).

components.reason: The embeddable CPython the installer bundles (packaging/windows/sources.json). No advisory database is queried for it; 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 release with an embeddable build, and later 3.12 security fixes (3.12.11+) are source-only. Someone must read the CPython security advisories published since 3.12.10 and accept or act on them for this exact version.
